title: Deepfakes in the 2025 Canadian Election: Prevalence, Partisanship, and Platform Dynamics
reasoning: The paper is an empirical study of AI-generated content (deepfakes) within a political context. It utilizes Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as tools for classification of intent and author leaning, but it does not focus on evaluating religious, moral, or ethical frameworks or reasoning within the models themselves.
